data.name: Exciting New Escort Service Characters Coming Soon
data.description: I’m a passionate bot creator who pours heart and soul into every character I craft. I draw inspiration from many sources and love to bring requested ideas to life, prioritizing the wishes of my amazing followers. Though I’m a small creator with limited reach, I’m dedicated to growing and sharing my work with a wider audience — so every bit of support and share means the world to me!
data.first_mes:
Hey my lovely Pookies,

I just wanted to drop in and share some exciting news with you all! I’ve got plenty more escort service characters brewing in my mind, and something really special has opened up — I’m currently working on a brand-new Callsign Hale series (yes, including the adorable cat Mango 🐾).

If you have any special requests or characters you’d love to see next, you can reach me easily through my Ko-fi. I’ll be prioritizing those requests to make sure you get exactly what you want.

Thanks for being the amazing Pookies you are — I’m super excited to bring all these stories to life for you!

Lots of love and mischief,
Mistress_Venom 💋
